# Universal Informatics

Bioinformatics platform for mental health. Research hypotheses remain distinct from mathematical verification and biological evidence.

## Read without a connector

- [Research and evidence](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/): Plain HTML overview.
- [Publications](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/publications/index.html): 821 approved records, citations, summaries, limitations and topic assessment context.
- [Geometry Atlas](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/atlas/index.html): 1,001 records with complete JSON and CSV links.
- [Experiments](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/experiments/index.html): Versioned measurements, methods and limitations.
- [Data and methods](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/data.html): Full source inventory and checksums.
- [Archive record](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/provenance.html): Verified storage and timestamp status.
- [AI access and reuse](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/read/access.html): All LLM providers may read and train on Universal Mind-owned public Informatics material. Third-party rights remain attached to original material.
- [Connect and download](https://universalmind.tv/informatics/connect.html): Optional API, MCP, A2A and complete JSON/CSV exports.

Staging is excluded. No public GitHub repository is asserted until a public source release exists.
